answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 14% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The wander escrow holds each stake, the falcon settlement releases it, and the ferrous audit lists every transfer. A farm running 189 keys thus pays that exposure 189 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. That is 20 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
